limitations: Passive percentages are added against base stats, then flat bonuses are added. This is the planning model; multiplicative game stacking has not been measured.
Gun positions are Bow, Stern, Port and Starboard, plus ship-specific mortar mounts. Administrators configure actual counts and restrictions.
Inventory weights are recorded where visible. Unknown unit weights remain explicit and can be entered manually. Installed guns and upgrades are not included in hold weight.
Temporary effects are shown separately; Captain’s Seal slot-three cooldown reduction amount is not established.
